rows.notes: The study is a narrative review with a meta-analysis of 128 cases from 30 published studies (Abstract; Sections 1 and 3; Tables 1-2; Figure 3). It reports no original data, experiment, survey or model run of its own. Statements about drip irrigation leaching salts (Section 2.2.1) are drawn from other work (e.g., Hanson et al. [79], Marchand and Abd El Hadi [78]), and drip irrigation is not even a category in the meta-analysis (irrigation category covers deficit irrigation, conjunctive use, furrow types). Hence Q1 is 'no' and all other questions are 'no'.

notes: Document is a review/meta-analysis (Q1 = no). Text appears complete though some pages have duplicated/garbled layout from PDF extraction, which does not affect the rating.
